description: Na₅Al(HO)₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_12_12 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one H and five O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to five H and six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.72 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.85 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Al, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Al, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Al, and one H atom.
